title: Segmented control
description: A row of radios wearing one pill. Switching views or modes, cast as a single control.
usage: For 2–4 mutually exclusive modes that switch content in place (Day / Week / Month). For settings that submit with a form, Tabs or Radio group may be the honest choice.
a11y: Real radio inputs underneath, so arrows keys and screen readers behave. The pill is presentation only.
